newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cargo yield ex-Germany Dm2.74 per kg Jan-July-CASS.
newsitem.headline: Cargo yield ex-Germany Dm2.74 per kg Jan-July-CASS.

text.p: The average yield per kg on the German air cargo market was 2.74 marks from January-July, CASS said.
Airlines carrying cargo from Germany transported 311,251 tonnes and earned 854.2 million marks in the first seven months of the year, monthly CASS statistics supplied to Reuters showed.
North America, the major market with a 32 percent share of tonnage, generated an average rate of 1.84 marks.
The second largest market, South-East Asia, had an average yield per kilo of 2.77 marks, while Japan/Korea generated an average rate of four marks.
The fast-growing South America region lay at 4.74 marks while South Asia, including India, showed a comparatively low average of 1.67 marks.

The statistics of CASS, the official IATA central accounting system between airlines and freight forwarders, reflect rates paid on the market rather than prices demanded by airlines for transportation services. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
